title: EditorialSource
description: P02-001 source/version/license record. This is a structural contract only; it does not certify that the source actually supports any claim, and it does not perform an independent rights or historical review. See packages/domain/src/editorial.mjs for the runtime validator this schema documents.

id.description: Stable slug, unique within the sources file.

revision.description: Stable revision/version identifier of this exact source state, e.g. a pinned commit or dataset version. Separate from 'id' (source identity) per P02-001. Required unless 'revisionNote' explains why none exists.

revisionNote.description: Required instead of 'revision' when the source has no stable revision identifier (e.g. a page the institution updates in place). Must not be filled in when 'revision' is present.

publishedOnNote.description: Required instead of publishedOn when no exact publication date exists. Must not be filled in when publishedOn is present.

reuseScope.description: What use this source's rights status actually permits, e.g. 'excerpted text and derived summary only'.

rightsNote.description: Why this rights status was assigned, or what is unresolved.

objectLocator.description: Locator of the specific object within this source that this exception applies to.

objectRightsExceptions.description: A general source license does not automatically cover every object inside it (e.g. a CC0 dataset containing one rights-managed image). List per-object overrides here. objectLocator values must be unique. Evidence that names no locator inherits the most restrictive status on this source, not the general one.

allOf.description: revision and revisionNote are mutually exclusive; exactly one is required.
publishedOn and publishedOnNote are mutually exclusive; exactly one is required.
